newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA NOV STATE INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT FALLS 8.0 PCT.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA NOV STATE INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT FALLS 8.0 PCT.

text.p: Bulgarian state industrial output
fell by a real eight percent in November against the same month
last year after falling 6.5 percent year-on-year the month
before, the National Statistics Institute (NSI) said.
BULGARIA STATE

Industrial production in the state sector alone totalled
214 billion levs in November and 1,248 billion levs for the
first 11 months of the year, NSI figures showed.
Industrial production in both the state and private sectors
amounted to 244 billion levs in November, down a real five
percent year-on-year, figures showed.
Output in the private sector posted a real 13 percent rise
year-on-year in November but could not compensate the fall in
the state sector because the private sector contributes to some
12 percent of the total production, the NSI said.
Ferrous metallurgy, coal and mining and sewing industries
posted a rise in output of real 17-25 percent year-on-year in
November, figures showed.
But state energy production, machine building, metal
processing, and food and beverage industry posted big falls in
output in November, erasing the gains in other sectors, the NSI
said.
Total production of goods and services in both the state
and the private sectors amounted to 338 billion levs in
November, down a real 10 percent year-on-year, the NSI said.
Total production for the first 11 months was 2,032 billion
levs, down a real three percent from the same period of last
year.
-- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-876032
